name: Korvan Ironclad Combat Boot
description: A full-ankle combat boot in matte dark olive, built from layered thermite-treated polymer over a steel-reinforced toe cap and heel strike plate. The outer shell is visibly armored — segmented panels with shallow ridges that channel impact force away from the foot. Lacing runs through metal eyelets to a side-zip closure for fast donning. Standard-issue aesthetic without being mil-surplus.
functionality: Rated for 40J toe-cap impact. Heel plate absorbs fall impact up to 3m drop. Anti-puncture midsole resists nail and glass penetration.
what_it_says: You work somewhere that can hurt you. Security, construction, enforcement — practical danger, not glamour.
story_hooks: A pair turns up with the serial numbers ground off — traced back to a security contractor that officially doesn't exist.
The anti-puncture midsole caught something — a needle loaded with a paralytic. The wearer never knew.

physical_description.visual_profile: Imposing full-ankle silhouette with visible segmented armor plating across the upper foot and shin. Aggressive industrial stance — purpose-built for impact resistance rather than aesthetics. The boot commands attention through sheer functional geometry.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit through the arch and ankle, locked down by side-zip closure. Reinforced collar sits mid-calf with structured support. Steel toe cap creates a slightly bulbous forefoot profile. Built for stability over movement fluidity.
physical_description.primary_material: Thermite-treated layered polymer shell with embedded steel-reinforced toe cap and heel strike plate. Metal lacing eyelets. Internal pressure-responsive dampening layer.
physical_description.texture: Matte polymer finish with tactile segmented ridging across upper surface. Sharp metal eyelets contrast smooth side-zip track. Minimal shine — anti-glare industrial treatment. Subtle grip-pattern sole.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte dark olive (official Tier 3 utility green). Charcoal-grey accent ridging on armor segments. Gunmetal metal hardware and eyelets. Black sole with grey tread channels.
closures: Side-zip closure with metal track and pull tab for rapid on/off
Metal lacing eyelets running full length — can be laced or left loose with zip closed
Friction-fit internal ankle collar with memory foam
distinctive_features: Segmented armor plating with force-channeling ridge geometry
Steel-reinforced toe cap visible as subtle raised seam
Metal heel strike plate creates audible impact signature
Korvan Industrial Footwear embossed logo on tongue
Integrated drainage grommets for wet environment use
Treaded sole with embedded micro-channels for traction on slick surfaces
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional — working-class safety and industrial standard. Affordable durability without luxury finish or customization.
physical_description.cultural_context: Security personnel, factory workers, field technicians, construction crews. Signals preparedness and practical self-sufficiency. Worn by people who expect their feet to take punishment. Sub-military aesthetic without official military branding.
physical_description.condition_typical: Arrives pristine with visible factory ridging. Quickly shows scuff marks and sole wear. Metal eyelets develop patina. Armor segments accumulate minor stress fractures and gouges from regular impact. Often seen with mud crusted in tread channels or industrial staining.
